title: Can a Small Team or Company Book a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: A team of up to five can book the whole boat from Funchal for a morning, afternoon or sunset trip, with an invoice in the company name. How to plan it.
heroAlt: Five colleagues in casual clothes on a white motor boat passing the village of Ponta do Sol
keywords: can a company book a private boat trip in madeira
team building boat madeira small group

images.prompt: Midday, seen from the water at a short distance: a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy cruising slowly past Ponta do Sol on Madeira's south coast. Five small adult figures in casual summer clothes on deck, seen from the side and behind, faces not visible. Behind them the village of Ponta do Sol with its seafront buildings, church and steep green slopes. Bright natural light, deep blue sea, true colours.
images.alt: Five colleagues in casual clothes on a white motor boat passing the village of Ponta do Sol
